title: cereus gracilis var. simpsonii
intro: Cereus gracilis var. simpsonii, commonly known as the Simpson's columnar cactus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Mexico, where it is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cereus gracilis var. simpsonii include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
